native.endianness: native ISA ABI; explicit wire conversion

windows.endianness: native platform ABI for host calls; canonical little-endian for Chimera wire messages; guest order is separate

linux.endianness: native platform ABI for host calls; canonical little-endian for Chimera wire messages; guest order is separate

bsd.endianness: native platform ABI for host calls; canonical little-endian for Chimera wire messages; guest order is separate

darwin.endianness: native platform ABI for host calls; canonical little-endian for Chimera wire messages; guest order is separate

android.endianness: native platform ABI for host calls; canonical little-endian for Chimera wire messages; guest order is separate

ios.endianness: native platform ABI for host calls; canonical little-endian for Chimera wire messages; guest order is separate

windows.desktop_bridge: host file/URL opener and process launcher; Aurora GUI is separate

host_oses: 32-bit Linux x86/ARM where supported by distribution

hosted_edition.command_bridge: portable built-ins plus small command alias table; no shell interpolation, pipelines or redirection
hosted_edition.isa_mapping_policy: host architecture aliases resolve to canonical ISA database IDs; inventory matches do not imply emulation or compiler support
limitations: not a full syscall/API compatibility layer
cross-ISA guest execution requires a separately validated backend
32-bit profile requires a 32-bit Python runtime and matching native dependencies
does not provide 64-bit guest execution on a 32-bit host
current macOS hosted profile is 64-bit only

endianness.native_mode: Use active ISA/platform ABI byte order; do not infer from pointer width.
endianness.real_mode: x86 real16 is little-endian; other ISA modes use their architectural definition.
endianness.compatibility_mode: Keep guest data order independent from host order and explicitly convert binary ABI structures.
endianness.emulated_mode: Guest CPU state controls guest endianness; all guest memory and MMIO operations use guest semantics.
endianness.mobile_mode: Select by device/OS ABI profile; emulator guest order remains independent.
endianness.format_detection: ELF EI_DATA and machine type must be validated before header decoding; unsupported endian variants are rejected.
endianness.status: policy-defined; backend-level endian tests remain required
